description.value: Café Gloucester is a long-running Cantonese café on Cambie Street serving breakfast through late night, with an all-day menu and mini set meals. It operates two locations — Vancouver and Richmond — and has an active online ordering and delivery presence. The Cambie Street location sits along a major cycling corridor in South Vancouver, making it a potential mid-ride dining stop.
